name: Inclam, S.A.
summary: Inclam, S.A. engages in the water engineering and environment business in Spain and internationally. The company undertakes water engineering works, including hydrology and hydraulics, planning and studies, and risks management works, as well as work management and institutional strengthening services; and engineering, procurement, and construction work contracts for water purification, waste water treatment, and water desalination facilities, as well as hydraulic works. It also develops management systems, such as information, decision support, governance, and early warning systems, as well as control networks; and software applications comprising hydrological and hydraulic software. In addition, the company engages in the provision of various services for climate change that include Co2 strategic consulting and emissions trading, mitigation plans and projects, adaptation strategies, and brokerage and trading. Inclam, S.A. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain.
